item.title: Note: UART monitor - observing transmission over UART
item.description: Connecting MSP430 to SIM900 When using UART, for debugging purposes, I needed to monitor what the MSP430 sends and what the second device (SIM900) responds. To do this, you need to remove the MCU from the LaunchPad and connect it independently (for example, on a breadboard). And connect the LaunchPad itself to the computer to monitor the UART. Wiring schematic of UART MSP430 -> Device so that on the computer you can see the Device responses:
